proposals.title: Blue Blueprint
proposals.note: Cool lines join the nodes, with a warm point on the active facet. Raise one palm to tilt the structure.

proposals.title: Copper Joint
proposals.note: Bring both palms closer, then angle them diagonally. The geometry shifts between arcs and a lattice.

proposals.title: Light Modulator
proposals.note: Monochrome, a diagonal slice and a rosette. Rotate both palms to move circles through bands of light, echoing the perforated discs in Moholy-Nagy’s sculpture.
